opinions.text: Appeal from the Recorder’s Court of the City pf Detroit, Michigan. (Prob-able jurisdiction noted, 350 TJ. S. 963.) The motion of David S. Alberts for leave to file petition to intervene, or in the alternative, for consolidation of this case with Alberts v. California, No. 61, October Term, 1956, is denied. The movant is granted leave to file a further memorandum in No. 61.
